profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Bold Penguin
profile.summary: With over a decade of experience in software development. Proficient in Ruby on Rails, with a focus on designing and implementing scalable software solutions. Previous roles at RVshare, PlayOn! Sports and Nestlé Health Science-Pamlab involved collaboration with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software products.
